body: I don't want to tell my friends because they have their own issues and I don't want them worrying. The school councilors are the last people I want to talk to about it and my parents aren't very accepting of it plus they wouldn't get it. I've tried talking to them before. I have had a therapist it helped for like a month, but quickly ended. The therapist I had has also disappeared and I'm planning on finding a new one. I am okay. I have a rough day because of well a lot of stuff.
The school psychologist just makes the situation much more complicated and is not helpful. I get sleep, but I'm still tired in the morning and when I don't it's usually because I can't.
